cipher.summary: Replaced OutputPackagingSeam's eager top-level `pdf-lib` import with a dynamic `import()` inside the PDF-generation branch, confirmed via before/after build manifest inspection that pdf-lib now ships in its own on-demand chunk (~177KB gzip) instead of every route's eager bundle, with zero contract or test changes.
cipher.risks: This is a client-bundling optimization only; if a future change needs pdf-lib synchronously at module init (e.g. a top-level constant built from a pdf-lib export), the dynamic import would need to move back up or be awaited earlier.
